claims.claim: neither Hot Brook lake (MIDAS 1076, 1072) appears in the 2025 DEP/VLMP data tables: no DEP or volunteer sampling station, no Secchi, chemistry or oxygen data
claims.note: a negative can only be checked in the tables themselves. notes: Blocked: the cited file is the human's own download and is not in the repository (the research note says the raw tables, 61 MB, were left out). The quickest fix is for the human to put LakesDataTables2025.zip (or the seven extracted tables) in docs/research_notes/fetched/ so the values can be checked in OVERALL_SUMMARIES, ANNUAL_SUMMARIES and DO_TEMP_PROFILES; maine.gov (DEP lake data page) and lakesofmaine.org (per-lake pages and the 2025 lake water-quality report PDF) would also serve, by hand. Two internal problems to check when the tables are in hand: Table 3.1-3 puts Faulkner's deepest reading at 4 m in a lake given as 3.7 m deep, and Baskahegan's 2011 reading at 7 m in a lake given as 6.7 m deep. The research note's 'Faulkner Lake (1064, Weston — Hot Brook's own town)' is wrong (the Hot Brook lakes are in Danforth and T8 R4 NBPP, per MDIFW 1949); the paper's Table 2 says only 'Weston', which is fine. The note's '1949: "slightly turbid", brown water' is not on the 1949 sheets (see MDIFW_1949). Files saved while searching: VLMP_2025.lsmdist.html, VLMP_2025.lsmdata.html, VLMP_2025.lakedata.html (LSM and archived DEP pages) and VLMP_2025.wqp_stations.csv / VLMP_2025.wqp_results.csv (Water Quality Portal), all in docs/research_notes/fetched/v2/.
